title: Automate changelog + onboard orion-guardian-13b v1.1 (metadata + perf profiles)
author: Lena Park
release_notes: Add Orion Guardian 13B v1.1 to model catalog with metadata, performance profiles, and automated changelog generation. Includes perf-calibrated profiles for xlatency targets and added validation tests. No breaking changes.
description:
Motivation: Onboard 'orion-guardian-13b' v1.1 (bugfix + tokenizer tweak) into the model registry and ensure perf profiles and release notes are generated automatically. This PR packages model metadata, performance profiles calibrated from the benchmark-lab runs, and small improvements to the changelog generator so new model onboards include structured release notes.

What this PR does:
- Adds model metadata JSON and schema-compliant fields (authors, license, hardware compatibility, recommended quantization presets).
- Adds initial performance profile (latency/throughput) for typical seq_len distribution and batch sizes collected from the perf lab.
- Adds validation tests in CI to assert perf profiles meet minimal shape & required fields.
- Extends changelog-generator to pick up model tags and performance highlights so release notes contain a short perf summary.
- Updates docs/models.md with onboarding checklist and reviewer guidance.

Checklist:
- [x] Metadata file added and validated (schema v2)
- [x] perf profile generated (p50/p95/throughput numbers) and validated against schema
- [x] changelog-generator updated and unit tested
- [x] CI pipeline runs and passes after fixes
- [x] Docs updated with onboarding steps

Testing and validation:
- Local perf runs on benchmark-lab (a100/s8) used to produce JSON profiles included here.
- Added unit tests under ci/registry-tests that assert presence of required keys: model_id, version, architecture, tokenizer, perf_profiles[].
- Changelog generator unit tests assert that a model tag and perf summary are present in generated release notes.

Rollback plan: revert this PR if downstream serving runtime rejects the metadata format; changelog-generator changes are backward compatible and gated behind a feature flag (env var CHANGELOG_STRUCTURED=true).
